summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on diagnosing why a specific facility's traffic data was not appearing on the main dashboard. It was noted that the facility might be flagged as 'mobile,' which could prevent it from showing up in standard reports.

To improve visibility, the team decided to add a placeholder (0) vendor sample for the company associated with the facility (ID 7957). This approach was preferred over arbitrarily assigning an existing vendor ID.

The conversation also included technical troubleshooting regarding data types (UInt64 vs. int64) in database sessions and refining SQL queries used to calculate total sessions and unique samples (`device_number_uniq_sample`) for a given facility, ensuring the correct aggregation logic was applied.
decisions: The team decided to add a placeholder vendor sample (0) for the specified company/facility data.
A revised SQL query was established to calculate total sessions and unique samples from `device_session_agg_5`.
action_items: Implement the addition of the 0 vendor sample and clear the cache.
Review the functionality on the following week.
